ai.title: AI Settings
ai.thinkingBudgetDescription: Controls how long the AI model can think. Higher budgets mean more thorough reasoning.

thinkingEffort.label: Effort
thinkingEffort.tooltip: Effort: how hard the model thinks before responding. Applies to reasoning-capable models.

ai.maxChatTurnsDescription: Limits how many recent chat turns are included in context.
ai.maxToolCallStepsDescription: Limits how many tool calls the agent can make before pausing.

economy.label: Economy (2)
economy.description: Minimal context to reduce token usage and improve response times.

default.label: Default ({{count}})
default.description: Balanced context size for most conversations.

plus.label: Plus (5)
plus.description: Slightly higher context size for detailed conversations.

high.label: High (10)
high.description: Extended context for complex conversations requiring more history.

max.label: Max (100)
max.description: Maximum context (not recommended due to cost and speed).

low.label: Low (25)
low.description: Limits tool calls to 25. Good for simple tasks that don't need many steps.

high.label: High (200)
high.description: Extended limit for complex multi-step tasks (may increase cost and time).

toolsMcp.title: Tools (MCP)

toolsMcp.name: Name

toolsMcp.urlRequired: HTTP MCP servers require a URL.
toolsMcp.urlProtocolRequired: URL must start with http:// or https://.
toolsMcp.oauthUnsupportedToast: OAuth connection failed. This server does not support OAuth.
toolsMcp.serverRequiresAuthenticationMessage: This server requires authentication. Enable OAuth and try again.
toolsMcp.serverRequiresAuthenticationToast: Server connection failed. This server requires authentication; try enabling OAuth.
toolsMcp.plaintextTitle: OAuth tokens and client secrets are not stored with system encryption
toolsMcp.plaintextDescriptionBefore: The system keyring is unavailable (on Linux this usually means
toolsMcp.plaintextDescriptionAfter: is not installed), so OAuth tokens and pre-registered client secrets for HTTP MCP servers are written to the local database without encryption. Any process that can read Bzyai's data directory can decode them. Client secrets are especially sensitive because they do not expire. Install a keyring service, reconnect, and re-enter any pre-registered client secrets to upgrade storage.
toolsMcp.oauthClientIdHelp: If the MCP server requires app registration, paste the app's client ID here. Otherwise leave this blank.
toolsMcp.oauthClientSecretHelp: Only fill this in if the MCP server provides a secret with the client ID.
toolsMcp.oauthScopeHelp: Scopes to request, separated by spaces. Leave blank to use the server default.
toolsMcp.redirectUriBefore: If you enter a client ID, make sure
toolsMcp.redirectUriAfter: is registered as a redirect URI with the MCP server. MCP servers usually provide a console for this.
